rationale: Earlier recurrence_map_v1 executions directly matched RQ-REC-001 but their Evidence Readiness was blocked by a dirty source tree. R2 prospectively repeats the complete registered weight x delay intervention on a clean source freeze with fresh seeds and explicit decision gates. Historical DATA remain unchanged.

design.control_note: At recurrent_weight=0 no recurrent edge is created. The three zero-weight delay labels are intentionally retained as internal duplicate controls for protocol compatibility; they are not treated as independent observations.

seed_semantics: Fresh seeds provide deterministic repeatability checks under the registered runner. Because this three-neuron construction contains no seed-dependent random topology, identical seed outputs are not interpreted as statistically independent replicates.
freshness_rule: Seeds are disjoint from prior REC-001 seeds 42-61 and 101-120 and from the recent Stage-1 temporal/topology seed ranges.

analysis_plan.inference_policy: No p-values or sampling-based confidence intervals are used. The runner is deterministic and the seeds are not assumed to be independent stochastic samples.
primary_decision_gates: Every seed must contain the full 15-condition grid and satisfy the 256-tick contract.
All zero-recurrence controls must have recurrent_events=0 and persistence_class=immediate_decay.
For every seed, at least one recurrent condition must be transient.
For every seed, at least one recurrent condition must be persistent_to_window.
For every seed, maximum recurrent last_response_latency must exceed maximum zero-recurrence last_response_latency.
For every seed, at least one nonzero recurrent weight must show a delay-dependent last_response_latency difference across d1/d2/d4.
For every seed, at least one fixed delay must show a weight-dependent last_response_latency difference across nonzero weights.
analysis_plan.support_status: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_PREREGISTERED_PROTOCOL only if all design-integrity checks and all primary decision gates pass.
analysis_plan.failure_status: NO_PREDEFINED_SUPPORT_DETECTED if execution is valid but one or more primary scientific gates fail.
analysis_plan.integrity_failure_status: NOT_TESTED_INTEGRITY_FAILURE if source freeze, coverage, tick contract, provenance, or runtime integrity fails.

integrity_constraints: clean source tree immediately before execution
exactly the registered weight x delay grid
256 ticks requested and executed for every run
claim_boundary: This experiment tests a small three-neuron SNN under the registered recurrence-weight and delay interventions and can support only the scoped claim that recurrence parameters change persistence/propagation classes in this deterministic operating envelope. It does not establish cognition, memory, biological equivalence, scaling, a 5D advantage, general recurrent-computation superiority, human-reviewed EVID, or independent replication.
